changelog: Polishes the homepage hero across screen sizes. Long titles and larger text can expand the desktop and tablet hero without clipping or covering controls; indicators wrap beneath the actions. Swipe left or right on the featured slide to browse titles and pause rotation until Resume is selected. Vertical scrolling, pinch zoom, native action taps, keyboard navigation, settings, identity, and normal plugin updates are retained.
description: A unified cinematic Jellyfin Web customization with a profile-forward login screen, Plex-inspired theme, and rotating library-driven home hero.
name: Cinematic UI
overview: Cinematic login and home experience for Jellyfin Web
